items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And Walter Johnson was on drums which to me is one of the smoothest drummers that ever lived.

ctx.x: And the drummer's name and guitar name I can't remember either. But they were very good. The drummer used to drum like the old Walter Johnson style, very smooth.
But they had a lot of good arrangements because Gus was writing then, you know. Gus was a very good arranger.
